profile.scope: Separate instrumented lane. GPU phases are asynchronous distinct measurement times; per-owner results are deduplicated by owner/sequence and may omit retired or budget-omitted owners. Work totals cover observed timestamp windows only. Nested GPU scopes overlap; do not add parent and child durations. CPU activation excludes render-thread allocation/submission. No replay/seek or screenshot/capacity scan.

admission_comparison_scope: Exact cumulative demand/accepted totals match within mode/tier for every available route across before/draft/final/visibility/light controls. Ordinary/profile lanes deliberately retain star-path bookkeeping only, so missing all-link records there are unavailable, not zero. All observed routes have zero source overflow, expansion omission and destination rejection.
image_control_scope: Signed difference of differences: combined-visible minus combined-hidden minus unlit-visible plus unlit-hidden, RGB 8-bit sRGB after HDR/bloom. ROI excludes new blue break core. At 6.9s latest count observation has zero younger star-path smoke and 11,209 older path particles, with no older luminous particles. Asynchronous image delivery, scattering approximation, alpha order and bloom prevent exact photometry/causal isolation.
